china-1931-2:p0488_2.rationale: Lists overdue principal on Peking internal loan issues subject to reduced interest; public debt balances.

china-1931-2:p0488_3.rationale: Overdue principal of Peking government loans whose redemption is deferred; debt balances.

china-1931-2:p0490_1.rationale: Bond drawing numbers and amounts for redemption of government bond issues; debt repayment.

china-1931-2:p0492_1.rationale: Original allotment of the 1900 Boxer Indemnity among the Powers by share, taels and foreign currency; a treaty-imposed indemnity obligation.

china-1931-2:p0494_1.rationale: Balance sheet of the China Foundation for education and culture, funded from the Boxer Indemnity; assets, endowment funds and liabilities. No tag fits an institutional balance sheet of a foundation.
review_questions: Propose a tag for foundation or endowment accounts.

china-1931-2:p0494_2.rationale: Appropriations and payments to universities and educational institutions for 1928-29 from the Foundation's funds.

china-1931-2:p0495_1.rationale: Boxer Indemnity appropriations and payments to educational, scientific and cultural institutions for 1927-28.

china-1931-2:p0495_2.rationale: 1928-29 Boxer Indemnity appropriations and payments to universities and schools with totals.

china-1931-2:p0497_1.rationale: Account of receipts and payments of the China Indemnity Fund held in Britain, covering indemnity payments, interest and bank balance.

china-1931-2:p0498_1.rationale: Cash and material loans made by the Board of Trustees from the Boxer Indemnity fund to a conservancy board and railways. No tag fits domestic loans from an indemnity fund.
review_questions: Propose a tag for loans made from an indemnity or trust fund.
